Frontend.reason: Tracker now freezes the same V1 cross-product TypeScript contract and storage limits as Lexi Words. The contract is not imported by any page or runtime in this step, so navigation, local-first stores, cloud-sync selection, AI, account behavior and all visible user flows remain unchanged.

Backend.reason: The coordinated formal Lexi repository contains the backward-compatible Supabase migration for a zero-storage Words summary and compact expiring handoffs. Tracker does not call these RPCs yet and does not upload or merge any existing local record as part of this step.

Admin.reason: The new contract has no administrator-visible learner content, per-user management action or editable policy. The existing whole-database capacity metric automatically includes its storage, while per-account row limits and retention are server-enforced; Lexi Control remains unchanged until a later step introduces an intentionally managed state.

Deployment.reason: No Tracker or backend production deployment is performed in this step. A future UI integration remains blocked until the exact Supabase migration is applied and remotely verified.

Verification.reason: The Tracker release gate passed with typecheck, oxlint, 72 test files and 458 tests, plus a production build and bundle review. The formal Lexi gate and dedicated migration scenarios also passed, the two TypeScript contract files are byte-identical, and no page or runtime imports the new contract.
